Heya all,

So I finally decided to order some body armor like I'd been planning for years.

I decided to get soft body armor because I can wear it more places (obviously). The idea that I can pay $600 and have extended invisible protection for the next 5+ years seemed too good to pass up.

I might not need it, but if I ever DO get in a gunfight of any sort, it certainly might be helpful as I may get hit center mass. It's also stab resistant ... I'd rather not test that, but I see it as a SMALL plus.

I needed a good trusted brand, so I decided to go with AR500 armor. Lots of good tests and pretty modular. I bought their flagship (more expensive) hybrid plates. Level IIIA protection and only .25 inch thick. I could have saved by initially getting level II, but I don't want to buy level II plates only to buy the best stuff later. I also believe the level IIIA will cause less bruising to internal organs if I'm hit. They also say to have armor that will stop your handgun, and I sometimes carry .357 sig so the extra rating helps me feel better about that.

I got the 10x12 front and back plates and the 6x8 side plates. It won't cover everything, but it does cover up quite a bit of the vitals.

I also bought two trauma pads because when I can wear them, it's that much more protection for only $60.

Later I will get another carrier to use hard armor / rifle plates with, but for now I had to choose one and I chose one I could wear to different places.

Why do I need it? Well, why not, and if it's comfortable I see it the same way I see my conceal carry weapon. I do sometimes walk my dogs for miles ... not through Detroit, but it's an area I feel it's better to make sure I'm conceal carrying in.

Well, just wanted to share, feel free to discuss
